# Update OAuth login timestamps only when token or grant data changes

setRefreshToken updates password only if different and widens httpRealm only when the granted scope set grows. Only an actual update adds timePasswordChanged and modifies the login. A matching unchanged login still suppresses creation of a duplicate. The changed-token test checks timestamp advancement, but this inspected test does not separately assert timestamp stability for an unchanged token. Its 50ms delay is test context, not a new timing style rule. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: OAuth saved-token update semantics.
